headlines.description: Federico Valverde netted a stoppage-time winner as Real Madrid beat AEK Athens 3-2 in Greece on Wednesday with another dramatic Champions League comeback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Valverde stunner seals Real Madrid comeback in Athens

headlines.description: Even Liverpool 's multi-million pound bench could not rescue a team floundering in Istanbul as a chaotic performance was punished by Fenerbahce as they twice came from behind to win 3-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greenwood leads Fenerbahce rally to end Liverpool's perfect UCL start

headlines.description: Erling Haaland struck a late winner as Manchester City edged a thrilling Champions League clash with RB Leipzig 3-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland haunts Leipzig again as Man City bounce back with win

headlines.description: Viktor Gyökeres grasped his opportunity as Arsenal beat Slavia Prague 2-1 in the Champions League on Wednesday, holding off a late charge by the hosts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Madueke, Gyökeres score as Arsenal hold off Slavia Prague
